scope: minimum closed-period reconciliation requested by the task brief; NOT the full I-10-A historical reconciliation

tolerance_frozen_before_run.reason: Holding the issuer's own printed 2-decimal growth rate fixed, a single-rate path can only reproduce the disclosed revenue to within the rounding of that printed rate; 0.01pp on a CNY 349bn base is ~CNY 34.9m, so a CNY 1m tolerance is deliberately tighter than the rounding and would flag a genuine basis error.

restatement_check.result: identical, so this anchor is NOT restatement-contaminated and no mixed-basis bridge is needed

residual_decomposition.issuer_print_rounding: the printed 14.96% is a 2-decimal rounding of the exact 14.9648%; this alone explains up to about CNY 16.7m of the residual
residual_decomposition.unexplained_by_the_model: the model has no volume/price, equity-production, intercompany-elimination, M&A, FX or inventory terms, so no further decomposition is possible from this model. It is a scope limitation, not a measured driver effect.

closed_period_probe.conclusion: the single-rate path reproduces the closed period only to the precision of the issuer's printed rate; the model provides no economic decomposition. This supports a FORMULA qualification and explicitly does NOT support an accuracy claim.

cross_year_continuity_check.implication: two consecutive disclosed periods use materially different rates, so a constant-CAGR reading of direct_growth is already falsified by the second period for this issuer

not_a_forecast: both periods were already public before this attempt ran; the probe is a historical_mapping_probe and must never be described as a three-scenario forecast or as accuracy evidence
